interpretation: 500 individual project-specific action instances: 10 additional visitor actions on each of the existing 50 original research passport routes. These are not 500 new source records, 500 separate features, or 500 independent verified improvements.
dataPolicy: All 50 source-backed research objects and original 72 HTML pages unchanged. The new panel is progressively added on client side through existing shared bootstrap.
sharedPalette: No new color names. CSS appended to the existing site-navigation.css.
limitations: Attributions and report timing are reported-only; not independently verified
Copy and download action use local browser APIs; no submission or server upload
BibTeX and citations explicitly refer to MicroportMap catalogue records, not invented original publication metadata
Field presence means documented, not verified
